title: Carnivore extension item, layer 0 (the base every kind extends)
description: The authored sidecar every item carries, named carnivore.json for every kind. The kind is still decided by the native manifest present; the sidecar never counts as the manifest. See docs/extension-contract.md.

kind.description: The item class. One L1 schema per value.

id.description: A bare id for a first-party item, <publisher>/<name> for a catalog item. Each kind tightens this.

name.description: The display name shown beside the id on the Plugins page and in warez.

api_version.description: The host contract version this item was written against; separate from version.

license.description: An SPDX identifier. Required for tier catalog.

tier.description: builtin: first-party, compiled in, removable. catalog: third party, run out of process. dev: sideloaded, developer mode only. core is not a tier for items.

scope.description: Where it may be turned on.

owns.description: Everything the item puts on disk or into the app, as lists keyed by what they are.

data.description: The stores the item keeps, one entry each, so export, inventory and purge find them without a table in core. Required for a cplug ([] means it keeps no data). ids are unique within the item (the parser checks that; a schema cannot). See docs/extension-contract.md section 8.

links.description: Where to read more. Each value is an https:// URL (L0-4).

keywords.description: Search terms and the census band (L0-5).

upstream.description: Honest credit for a wrapper around somebody else's tool (L0-6).

min_harness_version.description: The oldest Claude Code or Codex that loads the item, keyed by harness, each a range (L0-7).

version.description: The catalog's VERSION_RE: up to four numeric components and an optional pre-release.

kind.description: core: a core feature id. mcp: an MCP server the item expects.

name.description: A row of src/cplugs/sdk/permission_registry.py. The parser checks the name against the registry.

relative_path.description: Relative to the item's own storage folder (<state>/cplugs/<id>/ for a plugin): no leading slash, no .. segment, no backslash.

own.description: What an export of the owner's own scope does with the store.

share.description: What a share to another person does with it.

reason.description: Why, in words; shown in the export plan.

purge.description: What a purge of the plugin does with the store: removed or kept. Required on an entry that sits outside the plugin folder (root_setting or state_path); a store inside the plugin folder is always removed with it.

backup.description: vault: the save plugin backs this folder up into its vault as one folder unit (<plugin>.<data id>), with dedup, retention that never drops a sole copy, health and a restore to a new sibling folder. none (the default): not backed up by the product. Only a kind folder entry that is not itself a backup_destination may say vault.

id.description: Unique within the item; the full id is <item id>.<id>.

root_setting.description: A setting this item declares whose value is the store's root folder.

scope_by.description: The key that ties a row or folder to a subject; install means no subject.

secret_columns.description: Columns of a db store that hold secrets and are left out of an export. Only for kind db.

state_path.description: A store the plugin keeps directly under the app state folder by a fixed name (for example save's old restore point tree), relative to <state>/.

default.description: Only with root_setting: where the store lives, relative to <state>/, when the setting is blank (crate's bundles: crates).

role.description: store (the default) or backup_destination: a place the plugin writes copies meant to survive the loss of the original. A destination gets the folder rules (no symlink, iCloud, CloudStorage or Dropbox) and a same-disk warning.

provides.description: backup_points: this folder is where the plugin keeps the backup points of conversations (the vault). A crate asks the enabled plugin that declares it for the points to carry and to file, instead of naming a plugin. At most one entry per plugin, a folder store.

range.description: A version range: one or more comparators (>=, >, <=, <, =, ^, ~ then a version) separated by spaces (AND), or *. No || (L0-1). See docs/warez/01-base-and-kinds.md section 3.3.

external_code.description: Code an MCP server fetches at run time (npx, uvx), one entry per server. The version is the runner's exact version, never a range; sha256 is the hash of the downloaded tarball bytes (L0-2, L0-3).

server.description: The mcpServers key this entry covers.

version.description: npm semver (pre-release allowed) or PEP 440 exact version for uvx.
